definitions.explanation: The way something or someone is treated, managed, or dealt with. Applies to both physical handling of objects and the manner in which people or matters are dealt with.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{機械|きかい}→機械：02366_kikai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{扱|あつか}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: This machine is difficult to handle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧{扱|あつか}い⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{嫌|いや}→嫌：10232_iya⟧だ。
examples.english: I hate being treated like a child.

examples.japanese: ⟦{個人情報|こじんじょうほう}→個人情報：18842_kojinjouhou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{扱|あつか}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please be very careful in handling personal information.

notes:
{扱|あつか}い is the noun form of ⟦{扱|あつか}う→扱う：01862_atsukau⟧ (to handle, to deal with). It is extremely versatile and appears in many compound expressions.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜{扱|あつか}い: treated as ~ (used as a suffix)
- {扱|あつか}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧ / {扱|あつか}いにくい: hard to handle
- {扱|あつか}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{困|こま}る→困る：00861_komaru⟧: to have trouble dealing with

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{特別|とくべつ}→特別：01120_tokubetsu⟧{扱|あつか}い: special treatment
- ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧{扱|あつか}い: treating someone like a child
- ⟦{人間|にんげん}→人間：03523_ningen⟧{扱|あつか}い⟦されない→する：00392_suru⟧: not treated as a human being
- {取|と}り{扱|あつか}い: handling, management (compound noun)
- {取|と}り{扱|あつか}い⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧: handle with care
- {扱|あつか}い⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧: how to handle, way of dealing with
